clouds: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game texture, derived from the approved reference's TOP dark storm sky only. Generate one very wide 3:1 horizontal panoramic cloud texture, edge-to-edge with NO layout, no labels, no HUD, no weapons, no rocks, no mountains, no ground or horizon silhouette. Only heavy layered thunderclouds in charcoal and softly desaturated steel blue-grey. Match the sculpted believable clouds of the reference: dense dark masses interleaved with delicate pale cold grey rims, fine vapor details, lower shredded wisps. mountains_source: Use case: precise-object-edit / production environment texture. The reference is style guidance only. Create a single wide 3:1 panoramic strip of the distant cold mountain skyline from the approved TOP mockup, for a Doom game skybox. No game HUD or weapon or foreground courtyard, no text, no layouts. The upper 55 percent must be TRANSPARENT, with actual alpha transparency extending cleanly down to the irregular mountain silhouettes. All mountains in the lower 45 percent. Several staggered ridges: charcoal slate rock summits in front, softer desaturated steel-blue grey mountain silhouettes behind, pale blue-grey rain mist in valleys, low wisps hiding some distant summits. No snow, vegetation, fire, lava, orange light, buildings, or sky/cloud canopy. Broad rugged peaks and irregular narrow ridges, natural varied silhouette, detailed realistic rock texture appropriate to a high-quality game backdrop. Soft overcast blue-grey ambient light, dark but readable, no strong directional sun. Seamless horizontal wrap: mountain profile and tonal value agree at left and right edges. Mountains continue to the bottom edge, no floating island. Output only the panoramic RGBA mountain asset.
